D-12: Zero residual in user profile
Empty Home boot initialization
nodes.rationale: On healthy boot the backend initializes active_job with empty payload {id:'', title:''} so no job auto-opens and Home starts clean.

nodes.label: Session-scoped library persistence filtering
nodes.rationale: Jobs flagged session_scoped are skipped by library.json persistence so synthetic/demo data never pollutes the user's persistent job library.

nodes.label: #tour-spotlight-box pointer-transparent CSS spotlight
nodes.rationale: The spotlight cutout is a CSS border plus oversized box-shadow rather than an SVG mask, avoiding the QtWebEngine SVG-mask hit-test failure; layer and box are pointer-events:none so only the control card is interactive.
